ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى أٰلِهٖ عَدَدَ مَا فِي الْأَرْضِ وَالسَّمَآءِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin, `Adada mā fī ‘l-Arḍi wa‘s-Samā’.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the number of everything on the earth and in the sky!
blocks.review: Source prints مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَى أٰلِهٖ without وَ (and the transliteration omits 'wa `alā Ālihī'); transcribed as printed.

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَعَلَى جَمِيْعِ الْمَلٰٓئِكَةِ وَ الْأَنْبِيَآءِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā jamī‘i ‘l-Malā’ikati wa ‘l-Anbiyā’.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and all the Angels and Prophets!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ وَعَلَى سَائِرِ الْعُلَمَاءِ وَالْأَوْلِيَآءِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā ālihī, Wa `alā sā’iri ‘l-`Ulamā’i wa ‘l-Awliyā’.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family and all the Scholars and Saints!
